Name: Ice Cream Replacer
Author: dragonsir
Description:
[size=6]Currently compatible with 1.6 Update[/size]


[line]

[size=3]
This mod replaces the ice cream texture to look like a vanilla ice cream cone.

I have added 2 slightly darker and more defined textures so the ice cream stands out from backgrounds better. There is a configurable option to use the old texture if you prefer that one, or even the game's original version. You can either edit the Config file or, if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ installed, you can use the in game mod menu.[/size]

[size=5]Updates
[/size][size=3]Version 1.1.0- Added compatibility with 1.6 update. Added new textures with more definition. Added configurability.

[/size]
[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install the latest version of Content Patcher[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Install the latest version of Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ (if you want to change the texture in game).
[*]Download ONE of the main files of this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
